basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and marine life lover based in Vancouver, Canada. I recently got into the hobby of reef tank keeping and I'm eager to learn more about maintaining a thriving aquatic ecosystem. When I'm not tinkering with my reef tank setup, I enjoy watching sci-fi series and playing strategy games like All Star Tower Defense. I work as a junior software developer for a startup. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work or during weekends when I'm not out exploring the local beaches.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I studied at university. My knowledge about reef tanks is beginner-level, mostly gathered from online forums, YouTube videos, and trial and error with my own setup. I'm actively seeking to expand my understanding through community engagement and research.
